results.title: Flight crew, pilots highest at risk of dying from radiation-linked cancers
results.description: Researchers found flight attendants had about 50% higher odds of dying from a radiation-related cancer than the general working population.

results.title: US President Donald Trump picks White House aide Heidi Overton to lead the FDA
results.description: President Trump chose Heidi Overton to lead the FDA. She was deputy director of the White House Domestic Policy Council and helped lead the 2026 Central Africa Ebola response.
